in_hebrew.name: Cyrille
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Derived from Cyriacus, meaning 'lord' or 'master' in Greek.
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cyrille הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Cyrille is derived from the Greek name Cyriacus, which means 'lord' or 'master'. This name was popular among early Christians and was borne by several saints. In particular, Saint Cyril of Alexandria was a prominent early Christian theologian and bishop known for his contributions to the development of the Nicene Creed.

in_greek.name: Συρίλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Syros' meaning Syrian, with the diminutive suffix '-illos' added to indicate smallness or little one.
